title: SDLC Acceptance Criterion v1
description: A reusable acceptance criterion with repository-compatible AC identifier forms and optional traceability to objectives and findings.
$comment: A local AC-* identifier is suitable for a task-owned criterion. A work-item-qualified WI- or GH- requirement criterion preserves an existing work-item acceptance-criterion identity. Host validation must resolve objectiveRefs and findingRefs and must verify that criterion IDs are unique within their declared scope.

id.description: Stable acceptance-criterion identifier. It may be task-local or retain a canonical work-item requirement criterion identity.

description.description: The observable condition that must be satisfied for the criterion to pass.
examples: The corrected result includes current verification evidence for every required finding.

items.description: Objective advanced or satisfied by this criterion.

objectiveRefs.description: Objectives that establish why this criterion is required.

items.description: Review finding that motivates or constrains this criterion.

findingRefs.description: Findings that this criterion addresses or makes verifiable.

examples.description: The corrected result includes current verification evidence for every required finding.
